text:
Maria Chen: Hey team — OpalField just sent the board matrix. Can we sync on a minimal benchmark plan for perf/W + throughput? We want something shady-light for the marketplace page, and a deeper set for joint tech notes.
Devon Patel: SG. Quick ask — do we include int8 quant runs or stick to FP16 for initial sweep?
opalfield-eng: OpalField Eng: initial silicon favors FP16 on OF-A100X and int8 on OF-Edge512 (with TCM support). We'll provide kernel patches for the int8 path.
Ryan O'Connor: I'd vote FP16 for the public numbers, int8 as an appendix. FP16 avoids model quality caveats.
Anika Rao: Agree. Also want a fixed prompt set for throughput (long & short). I'll pull 3 production prompt families: chat-complex, summarization-short, embeddings-bulk.
Maria Chen: Perfect. Proposed minimal matrix: 1) FP16, sequence length 128 & 2048, batch sizes [1,8,32] for latency/throughput curves; 2) perf/W runs with sustained 1hr load @t=90% utilization; 3) KV-cache warm vs cold.
Devon Patel: For perf/W we need power telemetry schema. OpalField, can you stream power telemetry to our bench S3 format? bench-bot can ingest CSV with headers: timestamp,power_w,board_temp_c,fan_rpm,util_gpu_pct
opalfield-eng: Yes — we'll push to s3://redwood-partner/opalfield/bench/1761239999/raw/ by the end of day. We'll also include a small README with measurement method.
bench-bot: bench-bot: Incoming: default ingest expects CSV in UTC and gzipped. Sample CLI to run collection:
```
OPF_RUN_ID=opalfield-1761239999
python bench/collect_power.py --board OF-A100X --out ${OPF_RUN_ID}.csv.gz --duration 3600
```
Devon Patel: Nice. For kernel tuning, can we isolate changes: baseline (stock driver), kernel-1 (OpalField patch A), kernel-2 (patch A + vf-width tweak)? We should label builds clearly.
opalfield-eng: Will tag kernels as ofp-1.0.0, ofp-1.0.1, ofp-1.1.0. We'll provide git hashes + build instructions.
Anika Rao: I'll own the prompt harness and eval metrics. Ryan — can you own the dashboard screenshots and single-line summary for the marketplace blurb?
Ryan O'Connor: On it. Will capture 99th latency, mean throughput, and watt/token. Short blurb: "~X tokens/s at Y W, 1.2x perf over baseline" — TBD after data. :rocket:
Maria Chen: Timeline proposal: dry-run on internal lab (OF-A100X) tomorrow 10am PT, partner smoke on Friday, full sweep next Tue–Thu. Thoughts?
Devon Patel: Timeline works. Add a contingency slot for kernel rollout rollback (30m window) during smoke.
opalfield-eng: Friday smoke is ok for us. We'll have engineers on call during the Friday window.
bench-bot: bench-bot: Checklist created: ingest schema, run commands, kernel tags, s3 path, bench harness PR. Link: https://redwood.internal/bench/opalfield/1761239999 (private)
Anika Rao: I'll open the harness PR now and add the 3 prompt families + eval scripts.
Maria Chen: Great — next steps: @Devon confirm test runner image, @opalfield-eng confirm CSV delivery, @Anika open PR, @Ryan reserve console screenshots slot. I'll run the dry-run and share preliminary numbers in this thread.
Devon Patel: Test runner image is quay.io/redwood/bench-runner:2026-03-23. Using k8s node taints to pin to OpalField hw.
opalfield-eng: CSV delivery ETA: today 18:00 PT. We'll also include thermal / ambient notes in README.
Ryan O'Connor: Screenshot slot reserved Tue 09:30 PT.
Maria Chen: Awesome. If anything blocks, ping me. We'll keep public messaging minimal until we validate quality numbers. :thermometer:
Devon Patel: Minor note — include tokenization seed and exact model hash in artifacts so numbers are reproducible.
opalfield-eng: Will do. We'll attach model hashes and dockerfile variants.
bench-bot: bench-bot: Reminder scheduled: Friday 09:00 PT run-smoke reminder to #partnerships.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — wrapping up here. I'll post the dry-run results after 13:30 PT.
